Hi Keith,

I noticed Cal.com maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications alongside supporting HIPAA BAAs and DPAs.

Sprinto helps address this through continuous control monitoring, connecting directly to your cloud environments to monitor configurations and surface any control deviations across your frameworks in real time.

Would you be open to a brief conversation next week to see how this fits into your current setup?

Best,
Namratha
